01 / Case Study

EV Market Analysis

An end-to-end analysis of India's electric vehicle market using Python, statistics and Power BI.

Project Overview

From raw EV data to business insights

Cleaned, transformed and analyzed electric-vehicle market data to understand registration trends, manufacturers, models, state-wise adoption, pricing, battery range and units sold.

1,200+clean records
9manufacturers
253 KMavg. battery range
Workflow
Raw Dataset→Data Cleaning→ EDA→Statistics→ Visualization→Power BI
What I Worked On
  • Removed duplicate records and standardized manufacturer names.
  • Mapped missing State values using City → State relationships.
  • Cleaned registration dates and converted them into usable date fields.
  • Cleaned Price_INR and investigated missing values.
  • Reviewed Battery_Range_KM missing values and distributions.
  • Detected invalid and extreme Units_Sold values and prepared them for analysis.
  • Created visual analysis for registrations, manufacturers, models, states, price and battery range.
Business Questions
  • How are EV registrations changing over time?
  • Which manufacturers have the highest registrations?
  • Which EV models are most popular?
  • Which states show the strongest adoption?
  • How does price vary by manufacturer?
  • How does battery range vary across manufacturers?
  • Is vehicle price related to battery range?

🛒
Customer Analytics

Understanding what customers buy — and why

The project combines Python, SQL and Power BI to transform customer transaction data into clear business insights.

Project Overview

From transactions to customer insights

An end-to-end analysis covering demographics, purchase channels, categories, products, brands, discounts, payment methods, reviews, subscriptions and returns.

Pythondata analysis
SQLbusiness queries
Power BIvisual storytelling
Workflow
Raw Data→Cleaning→EDA→SQL→KPIs→Dashboard
Analysis Areas
  • Customer demographics and location analysis.
  • Online versus offline shopping behavior.

  • Purchase frequency and previous-purchase behavior.
Business Questions
  • Which products and categories attract the most purchases?
  • How does behavior differ between online and offline channels?
  • Which customer groups generate higher purchase values?
  • How are discounts related to purchase behavior?
  • Which payment methods are most commonly used?
  • Do subscription customers show different purchasing patterns?
  • What patterns appear in reviews and returns?

03 / Case Study

Airbnb Market
Analysis

An exploratory data analysis and BI dashboard project focused on listings, pricing, hosts, room types and customer engagement.

Project Overview

Turning Airbnb listing data into market insights

An end-to-end analysis of Airbnb listings using exploratory analysis and interactive visualization to understand neighborhood demand, room types, pricing, host concentration, availability and review activity.

48.9Ktotal listings
$152average price/night
1.62Mtotal reviews
Dashboard Highlights
  • Listings by neighborhood and borough.
  • Room type distribution.
  • Average price by neighborhood.
  • Average price by room type.
  • Top hosts by number of listings.
  • Reviews versus price relationship.
Key Insights Shown
  • Manhattan has the largest number of listings in the dashboard analysis.
  • Entire home/apartment is the most common room type.
  • Entire home/apartment has the highest average price among the room types shown.
  • The dashboard highlights host concentration through the top-host ranking.
  • Reviews and price are explored together through a scatter plot.
Workflow
Raw Data→Cleaning→ EDA→Visualization→Dashboard
PythonPandas NumPyMatplotlib SeabornPower BI EDA
Project Questions

What the analysis investigates

Which neighborhoods have the most listings? How does price vary across neighborhoods? Which room type is most common? Which room type has the highest average price? How concentrated are listings among top hosts? Is there a visible relationship between reviews and price?

PhonePe Transaction

Dashboard Overview

Exploring digital payment transaction patterns

The dashboard summarizes transaction amount, cashback and transaction count, then breaks the data down by month, status, category, gender, city and device. The project repository also contains the practice dataset and Jupyter notebook used for the analysis.

₹818Ktotal amount shown
6,155cashback shown
500transactions shown
EDA Areas
  • Monthly average transaction amount.
  • Transaction status distribution.
  • Average amount by category.
  • Average amount by gender.
  • Average amount by city.
  • Amount by device/platform.
Key Dashboard Signals
  • Monthly transaction amount changes are visualized as a time trend.
  • Transaction status is split into Success, Pending and Failed.
  • Category-level average amounts can be compared side by side.
  • Male and female average transaction amounts are compared.
  • City-level average transaction amounts highlight geographic differences.
  • Android and iOS transaction amounts are compared.

Dataset→Cleaning→ EDA→Visualization→Dashboard
PythonPandas EDAData Cleaning Data VisualizationDashboard

What the analysis investigates
